verdict.rationale: Jules architecture (isolated cloud VM per task, docs-3) plus API for automating many tasks (docs-9, docs-16) and tiered usage limits for 'power users & agent-heavy workflows' (docs-13, docs-15) support running multiple tasks concurrently, and community reports confirm handling 'large quantities of tasks' and dispatching many PRs at once (comm-11, comm-12, comm-16). However there's no explicit dashboard/UI feature for managing concurrent runs, and several community reports describe tasks needing heavy babysitting, stalling in loops, or hitting reduced daily limits (comm-8, comm-14, comm-18), undercutting smooth at-scale throughput. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a concurrency limit/dashboard for simultaneous tasks, and independent benchmarking of parallel task success rates at scale.
